root_idea.summary: The root centers on release from attachment, grief, or privation through forgetfulness, contentment, or consolation.
root_idea.development: The basic sense of becoming free from love or loss develops into causative and reflexive verbs, abstract nouns for consolation, and names for things believed to provide relief. The Quranic سَلْوَىٰ is also the name of a bird.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Classical Arabic citation form سَلْوَىٰ.

senses.definition: A bird, traditionally identified with the quail.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, سَلْوَىٰ denotes the bird provided as sustenance alongside manna. Broader Classical uses of the same word are listed separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become forgetful or unmindful of a person or thing; to endure its loss; or to become content without it and free from love, grief, or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with عَنْ for detachment from a person or thing. With أَنْ followed by a verb, it may mean to neglect or fail to do something rather than simply forget it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone forget or become detached from a person or thing; to make someone content without it; to comfort, console, or relieve grief or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative transitive use; عَنْ may introduce what someone is made to forget or relinquish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a people or party, to become secure from a beast of prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical use describing safety from predatory danger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To console oneself, become content, or make oneself forgetful of a person or thing; to become free from anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or effortful form that can express seeking or affecting consolation and detachment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For anxiety to be removed or clear away from a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The anxiety or distress is construed as the subject undergoing removal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of consolation, contentment, or patient endurance in the absence or loss of something; by extension, ease and pleasant abundance of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may denote either emotional relief or a comfortable, plentiful condition of living.
A reported Classical application of سَلْوَى distinct from the bird sense; some authorities reject this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything that brings forgetfulness, contentment, or happiness during deprivation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote a thing that consoles; honey is associated with this use because of its sweetness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A supposed consoling draught, medicine, or object used to relieve passionate love, grief, or privation and produce forgetfulness or contentment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Descriptions include water prepared with dust, a bead, a pebble, or a medicinal preparation; the reported explanations concern customary beliefs rather than a single standardized substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quality or condition that makes one forget objects of love or become content without them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract designation for the state or quality of emotional detachment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having the heart free from love or affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial description of a person whose attachment has ended or been removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means or cause of forgetfulness or freedom from anxieties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting something that provides relief from distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The third horse to reach the goal in a race of ten horses.
A place in which one may find consolation or become content without a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of place associated with the reflexive or self-consoling use of تَسَلَّى.

cautions: The Quranic form is normalized to سَلْوَىٰ rather than copying the internal QAC lemma display mechanically.
The Quranic occurrences are represented by the bird sense; broader Classical applications of the same spelling, including honey and a consoling thing, are kept separate.
The bird is traditionally identified with the quail, while the supplied lexical evidence does not establish a more precise zoological classification.
